taxes.summary: Her campaign platform says she will say no to income tax increases, fight for property tax relief including cutting and freezing taxes for seniors, create a Waste, Fraud and Abuse Commission to protect tax dollars, and focus the state budget on what she calls real priorities instead of wasteful big-government projects.
taxes.short: Opposes income tax increases; proposes senior property tax relief.

abortion.summary: Her campaign platform says she will protect the unborn and defend the sanctity of life.
abortion.short: Says she will protect the unborn, defend life.

education.summary: A teacher and school administrator for more than 30 years, she says schools should focus on teaching core skills such as reading, writing, math and science, and that she supports educational choice and parental rights and would keep what she calls woke ideology out of schools.
education.short: Supports core-skills focus, educational choice, parental rights in schools.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform lists preserving medical choice among the constitutional rights she pledges to protect; the site does not detail further healthcare positions.
healthcare.short: Pledges to preserve medical choice; no further healthcare detail.

guns.summary: Her campaign platform says she will preserve constitutional rights such as the Second Amendment, and support law enforcement and first responders to keep communities safe.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment; supports law enforcement and first responders.
